observations: Two manual treadle sewing machine stands with wooden table tops.
The stands consist of cast iron legs, a drive wheel, and a foot pedal.
The brand 'SUMO PREMIUM' is embossed on the foot pedals in photos 2 and 3.
One table top has a blue patterned finish; the other has a wood-grain finish.
Both table tops have cutouts for machine heads, but no heads are currently installed.
A green object resembling a small sewing machine motor is partially visible on the left edge of photo 3.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show the metal legs and table tops designed for sewing machines.
Sumo Premium is a brand typically associated with Chinese manufacturing; no Japanese origin marks are visible.
The photos show manual treadle stands; while a motor is partially visible in photo 3, it is not shown clearly or in operation.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories or manuals are shown in the provided photos.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong

risks.risk: The treadle and wheel mechanism may be seized, rusted, or stiff.
risks.proof: A video showing the wheel spinning freely when the foot pedal is pumped.

risks.risk: The wooden table tops may be warped or have structural rot underneath.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside of the wooden tops.

risks.risk: Missing drive belts and mounting hardware for the machine heads.
risks.proof: Photos showing the leather/rubber belts and hinge pins included.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the sewing machine heads if they are included in the sale.
A video of the treadle mechanism in motion.
Photos of the accessories and manual mentioned in the description.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as Sumo Premium sewing machine stands. They can be priced as stands only, assuming the worst-case condition for the mechanical parts and the absence of the machine heads.
